honing_confound: Full Bloom's healing output scales with Specialization (gear honing) — Artist's HP-based healing values (e.g., 7/11/15% of Artist's max HP) mean higher gear level → larger raw heal amounts. However, the primary party value of Full Bloom is its damage buff application and uptime, which scales with Swiftness (cooldown speed). Dual-stat confound applies.

delivery.evidence: Full Bloom Artist's primary output is party support: Sunrise (X) launches HP-bubbles at allies within range; Moonfall (Z) applies a damage debuff to enemies in AoE. Paint brush skills provide some personal damage but the identity delivery is buff/heal-to-target, not personal damage. Range is support-wide (24m for Full Bloom Sunrise).

footprint.evidence: Full Bloom Sunrise: heals all party members within 24m radius instantly (Full Bloom identity). Moonfall: AoE zone that applies damage debuff to enemies. Support skills are wide-area by design.

geo_text: Full Bloom Artist uses 3 Harmony Orbs (filled by attacking with paint brush skills). Orbs power two identity skills: Moonfall (Z, costs 2 orbs): AoE mark on enemies increasing damage taken by ~10%. Sunrise (X, costs 1 orb): launches a heal bubble targeting a single party member (25% HP heal) with AoE component (15% HP). FULL BLOOM IDENTITY: Sunrise instantly heals ALL party members within 24m for 7/11/15% of Artist's max HP instead of single-target. Full Bloom Artist's role: buff party damage, shield, heal, reduce incoming damage. Harmony Orb cycling governs support skill availability.

control.evidence: Support class — no CC identity. Paint skills do some damage but no CC output.

defense.evidence: Light armor. Support classes are typically mobile but fragile. Artist toolkit includes shields for party members — some personal shield coverage via proximity. Dodge-based personal defense.

economy.resource_verbatim: Harmony Orbs (3 max) + Ink Energy stacks (Combat Technique, max 9)
economy.builder_source: Paint brush skills fill Harmony Meter → Harmony Orbs (max 3). Each Harmony Orb used generates 1 Ink Energy stack (Combat Technique mechanic). Ink Energy stacks at max 9 enable additional combat effects.
economy.plain_text: HARMONY ORB ECONOMY: Attacking fills Harmony Meter → generates Harmony Orbs (max 3). Orbs power Moonfall (2 orbs) and Sunrise (1 orb). COMBAT TECHNIQUE (Ink Energy): each orb used → 1 Ink Energy stack (max 9). Stacks enable additional effects (mana recovery, cooldown interaction per Ark Passive nodes). FULL BLOOM MODIFIER: Sunrise becomes an instant party-wide heal within 24m. Economy: cycle through Moonfall/Sunrise as orbs fill to maintain buff uptime and healing coverage.

element.evidence: Artist uses ink and paint. Support skills (Sunrise, shields) have Holy/Light element. Paint damage skills are Physical with artistic visual design.

movement.evidence: Moderate mobility for a support. Paint skills are rooted-cast. Dodge-based repositioning to maintain party proximity for 24m Sunrise range.

attr.evidence: Support-range: Full Bloom Sunrise heals within 24m. Moonfall applies to enemies in AoE at combat range. Artist can support from a distance — doesn't need melee proximity like melee supports.

range.evidence: Full Bloom Sunrise: 24m party-wide heal radius. Moonfall: AoE at casting location, likely 8-15m. Identity skills have extended support range.

tempo.evidence: Full Bloom is sustained support: cycle Harmony Orbs to maintain party buffs, damage debuffs on enemies, and healing coverage. No discrete burst window — consistent support throughput.

amp.value: Full Bloom Sunrise: instant party heal 7/11/15% max HP within 24m; Moonfall: ~10% increased damage taken debuff on enemies; additional shields and damage reduction from broader Artist skill kit

proxy.evidence: No proxy mechanics. Sunrise bubble is a targeted heal projectile, not an autonomous entity.

commitment.evidence: Paint skills have brush-stroke animations. Support skills have short cast times. No long channels.

mechanics_notes: 1) FULL BLOOM IS THE PARTY HEAL SPECIALIST in LA: the instant 24m-radius party-wide heal makes Full Bloom Artist one of the two primary healing supports (with Bard). However, Full Bloom is generally considered LOWER HEALING CEILING than Desperate Salvation Bard in high-end raids. 2) MOONFALL DAMAGE DEBUFF: the damage-taken debuff on enemies (from Moonfall) provides party DPS amplification — Artist's primary 'buff' contribution to party output is through enemy vulnerability, not direct attack power bonuses. 3) INK ENERGY / COMBAT TECHNIQUE system: each Harmony Orb spent generates a stack (max 9). This system is layered on top of the base economy and provides Ark Passive-specific node effects. 4) C2 RULING PREDICTION: negative-for-solo. Full Bloom Artist requires a party to deliver meaningful value — the heal and debuff toolkit is designed entirely around supporting other players. Solo output is minimal. 5) Artist is SUPPORT-ARCHETYPE — group_context: true. Without a party, Full Bloom provides essentially no combat advantage over a DPS class.
stabilization_patch: Full Bloom has been the primary Artist identity for support play since KR addition; Recurrence is the DPS alternative.
tier_standing_current: A-tier support (contextual — support tiers measured by raid group desirability, not DPS output). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: heal values scale with Artist max HP (honing-indexed) and Specialization; confound applies to absolute heal numbers, not buff uptime.

honing_confound: Recurrence's Crit Damage bonus (+20-40% CD) compounds with Crit Rate gear at T4. The 60-second buff window from Moonfall/Sunrise activation means a sustained honing-compounded critical burst phase. Swiftness-indexed speed reduces buff downtime. Dual-axis confound (Crit Rate gear × Crit Damage identity buff).

delivery.evidence: Recurrence Artist uses Paint brush skills as primary DPS: Paint: Crane Wing (fast brush strike), Paint: Pouncing Tiger (heavy brush slam), Stroke: One Stroke (sweeping arc). Medium-close range brush attacks. Moonfall/Sunrise activate identity buffs — delivery is personal DPS via paint skills.

footprint.evidence: Paint brush attacks: small arc and cone footprints. No wide-zone identity. Stroke: One Stroke creates a wider arc but still limited.

geo_text: Recurrence Artist uses Harmony Orbs (3 max, filled via combat) to activate Moonfall (Z, 2 orbs) or Sunrise (X, 1 orb) for a personal buff trigger: Crit Rate +6-12% and Crit Damage +20-40% for 60 seconds. Between buff activations: cycle Paint DPS skills (Paint: Crane Wing, Paint: Pouncing Tiger, Stroke: One Stroke). RECURRENCE IDENTITY: Moonfall/Sunrise activate personal Crit amplification rather than party healing (Full Bloom). Paint: Sun Well provides +30% Attack Power buff. Paint: Butterfly Dream applies brand (+10% damage taken on enemy) for party DPS amplification.

control.evidence: No CC in Recurrence identity. Paint strikes have stagger effects but no CC-centered identity.

defense.evidence: Light armor. Dodge-based defense. Lower survival toolkit than Full Bloom (no party shield access in DPS configuration).

tempo.evidence: Recurrence 60-second buff window is sustained — much longer than typical burst windows. Paint skill cycling within the extended buff window provides consistent amplified output rather than a discrete spike.

mechanics_notes: 1) RECURRENCE IS THE DPS IDENTITY of the Artist class pair: instead of party healing, Recurrence converts Moonfall/Sunrise orb activation into personal Crit amplification. Same orb economy; different identity output. 2) 60-SECOND BUFF WINDOW: much longer than typical LA identity windows (most last 15-30s). This means Recurrence has very low downtime between amplified phases — the 60s buff covers most of a raid encounter phase. 3) BRAND APPLICATION (Butterfly Dream): Recurrence Artist contributes party DPS via the +10% enemy damage taken brand — a group-benefit rider even on the DPS identity. This makes Recurrence Artist mildly support-adjacent even in DPS configuration. 4) RECURRENCE vs FULL BLOOM DESIGN: same base class, one modifier per path. Full Bloom makes Sunrise a party heal; Recurrence makes Moonfall/Sunrise a personal Crit amp. Clean single-function fork — the simplest identity fork in the LA corpus. 5) Solo-viable as a DPS class; lacks the pure healing ceiling that makes Full Bloom valuable in groups.
stabilization_patch: Recurrence is used when the raid group has sufficient healing from Bard/Paladin and Artist is filling a DPS slot.
tier_standing_release: B-tier DPS at global addition (Artist as DPS was initially niche)
tier_standing_current: B/C-tier DPS (Recurrence is viable but not meta-leading). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Crit Damage +20-40% compounds with T4 Crit Rate gear for meaningful ceiling — but Artist as DPS doesn't reach top-tier DPS numbers.
